description: PR-AQ continuation: ordinary-play chain through repaired refusal grammar and grounded investigation, then walk/listen physical-action typing and one further natural action.

scenarios.initial_objective: Learn the missing-patrol route, pursue it, investigate, return, observe, reread the board, bind the Guard Captain, receive a legitimate first-ask answer, inspect the referenced roster, look around, ask the tavern runner what stew costs, glance back at the notice board, ask who last checked that board, thank the runner and look toward the gate line, walk a few steps along the muddy gate line and listen, then take one more natural action.
scenarios.content: frontier_gate ordinary local walk/listen typing, no invented sound, no accidental travel
player_prompts: I step closer and read the notice board carefully.
Fine. I'll follow the missing patrol rumor along that northwest mud track.
I'll head back to the gate.
I read the notice board again.
I turn to the Guard Captain. "What's being done about the missing patrol?"
If the watch already has a commander on this, I'll check the roster board the serjeant is watching.
I look around the gate again after that.
I step over to the tavern runner and ask what the stew costs.
I glance back at the notice board after that.
I step back to the tavern runner and ask who last checked that board.
I thank the runner and look toward the gate line again.
I walk a few steps along the muddy gate line and listen
I look toward the notice board again.
